subject.title: feat(ui): guided Model Setup page — web/Linux equivalent of the macOS Connect-your-AI flow

question: Before merging this first-run setup flow, what real-environment evidence is required for the automatic redirect and privileged provider-auth paths?
rationale: The implementation is maintainer-authored and directionally aligned, but its new landing behavior and real OAuth or CLI activation paths have upgrade and provider effects that mocked Gateway coverage cannot settle.

options.title: Require focused live proof
options.body: Demonstrate a fresh browser or Linux companion setup plus an upgraded configured Gateway, covering one detected-login activation and one OAuth or token flow before merge.

options.title: Accept automated coverage
options.body: Merge based on the focused unit, view, and mocked browser suite while owning provider-specific or upgrade issues as follow-up fixes.

recommendation.title: Require focused live proof
recommendation.body: Demonstrate a fresh browser or Linux companion setup plus an upgraded configured Gateway, covering one detected-login activation and one OAuth or token flow before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the PR, official product direction, and substantial onboarding and model-auth history.
